userSuppliedThesis: The layout is a form with its own texture; gestures translate across technical apparatus, carrying meaning and energy over time, and can be exploited, recalled, subordinated or brought back. These are the user’s artistic propositions, not experimental findings.

implementationClaims.web: Availability and tolerance for delay are Jeffrey’s supplied design priorities; no controlled cross-platform benchmark claimed. Actual response depends on device and browser.
implementationClaims.acos: Low-latency/boot-to-instrument claim scoped to supported hardware; no universal numerical claim.
implementationClaims.menuband: Source verifies WAV and MIDI export, General MIDI palette, virtual CoreMIDI routing. Uses precise audio/MIDI export language; does not claim automatic mastering or identical App Store/full-build export options.
implementationClaims.audioInterfaces: Ableton Live is a recording application, distinct from audio-interface hardware. No claim that web/Linux require proprietary drivers: Chrome supports output-device routing and ACOS kernel enables USB audio.
implementationClaims.sharedCode: User explicitly states some code is shared, while each implementation should fit its machine natively; preserved as artistic rationale.
